scope: new isolated synthetic acceptance workspaces only
authority: user-approved integration implementation; independent fixture setup, not real-user consent
stage: after original full seed verification and before first task message/paid request

request.authentication: same isolated workspace real Cookie + CSRF; expected_revision from real current service

allowed_setup_effects.explanation: Only the normal settings endpoint permission/version/audit bookkeeping; no direct SQL setup writes. Persist full before/after diff and reject any undeclared table/field change.

required_unchanged: existing candidates and history must be empty before this setup
all graph cache tables and existing decisions: must be empty before setup, no silent cleanup credited

post_setup.baseline: preserve original verified baseline and additionally seal post-setup baseline before task messages

stop_on: existing history/candidate data in fresh fixture
budget: record setup wall time and exclude it from model/tool semantic credit; task execution still has one shared105 second deadline; total stage budget includes setup
forbidden: writing fake history or approved candidates
altering original questions, amounts, grading or seed source closure
treating setup permission as financial action authorization
results_label: base tasks executed under explicitly frozen synthetic-history prelude; original no-prelude variant remains not_run if history unavailable
